title: JD Vance shares narrow redefinition of citizenship - Main Stream Videos
text:
Vice President JD Vance, at a recent speech to a conservative think-tank, seemed to call for a redefinition of citizenship where some in the U.S. had more of a claim to being an American than others. Hosts of MSNBC’s The Weeknight react to Vance’s remarks.
